items.title: The cycle of a flat-in-high-dimensions closed subscheme is a relative cycle
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: 6 行陈述（6 行证明）、闭子概形循环的相对性：平坦假设转写为 O_Z 平坦 + 模版本特殊化引理直接套用（F = 推前结构层）。2 处引用全具名，无 omit，干净收。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-family-associated-closed-specialization (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1146-1151

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Flatness of Z over S in dimensions >= r means the structure sheaf of Z is flat over S in those dimensions; the closed-subscheme cycle [Z/X/S]_r is the family-associated-module cycle of the pushforward of that structure sheaf, so the module version of the specialization compatibility applies verbatim and [Z/X/S]_r is a relative r-cycle (source lines 1153-1158)
